name: Tower of Althalaxx
summary: Dark sorcery stirs within the Tower of Althalaxx on northern Darkshore's coast. Once Athrikus Narassin's retreat, the ancient Highborne spire now shelters demonic cultists and warlocks.

sections.title: A Highborne Retreat
sections.body: Queen Azshara settled favored Highborne servants in Ameth'Aran and Bashal'Aran ten thousand years ago, placing the powerful sorcerer Athrikus Narassin in authority over them. As he grew distant from civic governance, Athrikus chose to isolate himself in the nearby Tower of Althalaxx. The Great Sundering shattered ancient Kalimdor, but the tower endured on Darkshore's desolate coastline, a quiet ruin of forgotten elven magic.

sections.title: The Dark Strand
sections.body: The Tower of Althalaxx stirs with malignant sorcery. Warlocks, dark cultists calling themselves the Cult of the Dark Strand, and allied satyrs have gathered in the ruin under Athrikus Narassin's leadership. Their rites channel demonic magic and torment the lingering spirits of the ancient dead, serving sinister designs tied directly to the demonic Shadow Council.

faq.q: What is the Tower of Althalaxx?
faq.answer: On northern Darkshore's coast, the Tower of Althalaxx is an ancient elven mage tower from Queen Azshara's reign, now occupied by dark sorcerers and cultists.

faq.q: Who originally built and lived in the tower?
faq.answer: Athrikus Narassin, a powerful Highborne sorcerer, was placed in authority over Ameth'Aran and Bashal'Aran by Queen Azshara. He retreated to the tower when he grew distant from civic governance.

faq.q: Who are the cultists occupying the tower now?
faq.answer: The Cult of the Dark Strand occupies the tower, with warlocks, cultists, and satyrs practicing dark rites in its ruins.

faq.q: Why are there ghosts and tortured spirits here?
faq.answer: The cultists torment the long-dead elven spirits of ancient Darkshore with dark rituals and soul-binding magic, using their agony in spells.

angles.text: For a night elf, the tower is a grim reminder of Highborne corruption and demonic folly on ancestral lands, and calls for swift intervention from Darnassus.
As a warlock, you can see the Cult of the Dark Strand's dark rites as proof of the Shadow Council's far-reaching influence and lingering presence in Kalimdor.
